source_failed_validation.development_reuse_rule: VAL-007 labels may be used only after the failed independent evaluation was frozen and reported. They are development evidence for 2.3.0-dev and can never serve as independent validation for 2.3.0.

candidate_rules: recognize singular and plural audiovisual route families: film/video/movie/audio/clip
strip trailing route structure through segment parsing so specific audiovisual descendants remain observable
use audiovisual type values in query parameters for fiche/detail pages
allow direct public media to confirm a generic audiovisual detail route
treat author/creator/category/genre/tag query filters as search_or_index when no item decision already exists
distinguish configured observation roots from semantic homepages when generic browse/index evidence exists
recognize unresolved multilingual collection routes as archive_landing_page without overriding an existing institutional landing decision
prohibited_rule_design: no retroactive edits to VAL-007 human labels
no modification of frozen 2.2.0 predictions or evaluation

original_blind_calibration_v1.regression_constraint: exact surface, item-level and access-state replay preserved

val003_v2.regression_constraint: exact surface, item-level and access-state replay preserved

val007_v2_2.note: Metrics below are in-sample post-validation development replay and must not be cited as independent protocol performance.

remaining_error_families: BBC complaints surface remains unknown vs human archive_landing_page
BNT FIAT/IFTA surface remains unknown vs human archive_landing_page
one BNT request_error surface remains restricted_or_unavailable vs human search_or_index
one BNT news-path surface remains news_or_editorial vs human search_or_index
one BNT news-path surface remains news_or_editorial vs human archive_landing_page
one BNT news-path audiovisual surface remains news_or_editorial vs human audiovisual_item

development_gate_interpretation.reason: The candidate was designed after observing VAL-007 human labels and failure patterns. Passing those same numeric gates in replay is an in-sample development result and provides no independent evidence of generalisation.

requirements: freeze the final candidate implementation before sampling
preregister unseen entities and deterministic sampling before execution
exclude all 117 known development URLs from the new independent sample
freeze model predictions before any human labels are entered
complete and freeze blind human review before opening predictions
apply acceptance thresholds without post-hoc substitution or tuning
do not scale M4 unless all preregistered M3 item-level gates pass

prohibited_interpretations: do not report 80.65% exact accuracy as independent 2.3.0 performance
do not report 92.86% item recall as independent 2.3.0 performance
do not use VAL-007 again as validation evidence for 2.3.0
do not scale M4 from this development replay
do not modify the official T2 baseline
